headline: MIN @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.98 at ARI 4.59, with a projected total of 8.57. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: MIN moved -0.51 runs while ARI moved +0.30, changing the projected margin by -0.81 runs. NRFI probability dropped -5.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Michael Soroka has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Bell, Byron Buxton, Ketel Marte, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas, Jorge Barrosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
